EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches and deformations (2955, 2854–2896, 1454 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003), two intense bands at 2773 and 2820 cm⁻¹ suggestive of a characteristic split CH stretch from Fermi resonance (SPC-002) often seen for aldehydic/acetal-type CH environments, a very strong band near 810 cm⁻¹ consistent with an NH₂ wag, and medium features at 1019 and 1150 cm⁻¹ consistent with ether C–O stretching. The presence of an NH stretch near 3342 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002) further supports a primary amine. Candidate 2 (COC(CN)OC) uniquely combines a primary amine with two ether (methoxy) groups and an acetal CH, matching the CH/O/N pattern and the distinctive 2773/2820 pair.
